original_rule_reviews.exact_definition: 10 Nov to 30 Nov

original_rule_reviews.exact_definition: 15 Apr to 10 May

original_rule_reviews.next_action: Match the farmer’s grain cultivar and season to the trial and current extension map before proposing a date.

original_rule_reviews.soil_water_context: Wetting frequency, root-zone water status and stage dates need matching. The repository abstract gives no transferable parcel calibration.
original_rule_reviews.next_action: Obtain the methods, stage boundaries, cultivar and field wetting schedule for a separate ETc assessment.

original_rule_reviews.exact_definition: Spring wheat uses cereal-group initial 0.30, mid 1.15, end 0.25–0.40. For winter wheat on non-frozen soil FAO lists initial 0.70.
original_rule_reviews.original_locator: Table 12, cereals, spring and winter wheat, footnote 10
original_rule_reviews.cultivar_purpose: Spring-habit grain wheat versus winter-habit wheat
original_rule_reviews.finding: FAO-56 distinguishes spring-habit and winter-habit wheat and harvest states. The planting season in Egypt cannot resolve growth habit. These are reference values for an optional water-demand calculation.
original_rule_reviews.soil_water_context: Initial wetting, non-frozen soil where applicable, humidity, wind and harvest moisture affect choice.
original_rule_reviews.next_action: Confirm the habit of the named cultivar, stage lengths, wetting and harvest condition before any ETc use.
original_rule_reviews.original_limitation: Winter sowing does not determine growth habit. Match moisture/harvest and initial wetting.

original_rule_reviews.exact_definition: Early to mid-October preferred, with mid-September to end-October described as broader guidance
original_rule_reviews.finding: The Mansoura forage course prefers early/mid-October. FAO describes a wider Egyptian practice period and fewer cuts from late sowing. The two sources differ in purpose of the calendar. Neither promises a Sakha November stand or May forage.
original_rule_reviews.soil_water_context: Confirm drainage, hard layer, establishment irrigation and preceding crop clearance.
original_rule_reviews.next_action: Ask whether this is multicut green forage, one-cut forage, seed or dual-purpose. Record actual sowing and type.
original_rule_reviews.original_limitation: Check local weather, predecessor harvest and type. University guidance does not define Sakha cutoffs.

original_rule_reviews.exact_definition: Fahl single-cut, Meskawi multi-cut
original_rule_reviews.source_season: Winter forage, distinction repeated in Egyptian field literature
original_rule_reviews.finding: Fahl is a single-cut type and Meskawi a multicut type. The Fahl paper measured forage and seed separately. Its seed-yield treatments cannot parameterize a multicut forage plan.
original_rule_reviews.soil_water_context: Study and farm regrowth, irrigation and drainage must match before using any cutting guidance.
original_rule_reviews.next_action: Verify named cultivar, type, intended end product and whether regrowth is being retained for seed.
original_rule_reviews.original_limitation: Record intended forage or seed use. A seed crop can occupy the field beyond a forage cut.

original_rule_reviews.exact_definition: First 50–55 days after sowing, then 25–30 between cuts
original_rule_reviews.finding: The course intervals concern regrowing forage. Climate, establishment and regrowth explain why a teaching interval cannot validate that feed will be present on a protected date.
original_rule_reviews.soil_water_context: Water deliveries between cuts and temperature affect regrowth. Ask for observed stand condition.
original_rule_reviews.next_action: Obtain the last actual cut, next protected cut, stand status and any separate feed-quantity commitment.
original_rule_reviews.original_limitation: Temperature, establishment, irrigation and regrowth matter. The teaching range cannot fix a promise date.

original_rule_reviews.next_action: Record stand termination, removal and first usable day independently. Keep 200 in the historical calculation only.
original_rule_reviews.original_limitation: Final cut is not equivalent to first free day. No evidence here for a sixth cut or release interval.
original_rule_reviews.change: Retained original claim, evidence, scope status and approval. Added scoped review requirements.

original_rule_reviews.original_limitation: Ceasing cutting early, grazing, regrowth or seed retention can change occupancy. Feed quantity unknown.
